description: This file defines a span class template for referencing contiguous sequences of objects, along with associated traits, formatters, and logging support. It includes implementation details for constructing spans from various containers, comparison operators, and custom formatting logic.

classes.name: ocudu::span
classes.description: A class template representing a view over a contiguous sequence of objects, providing methods for access, slicing, and comparison.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the span.

methods.name: size_bytes
methods.description: Returns the size of the span in bytes.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the span is empty.

methods.name: front
methods.description: Returns a reference to the first element.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Returns a reference to the last element.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses element at a given index.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the underlying data.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the first element.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the element following the last.

methods.name: rbegin
methods.description: Returns a reverse iterator to the last element.

methods.name: rend
methods.description: Returns a reverse iterator to the element before the first.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns a span over the first 'count' elements.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns a span over the last 'count' elements.

methods.name: subspan
methods.description: Returns a span over a subrange starting at 'offset' with length 'count'.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two spans have the same elements.
